item.title: Build 349
item.description: Build 349. Send Log to James now sends straight to James: type your name and what happened, click Send. No email app needed. PictureFollows also starts the way you left it: if it was On, it comes back On after an update or a restart.

item.title: Build 341
item.description: Sessions that don't start at 00:00:00:00 now line up: the picture, the clip check and the log read your session's own start. New in the menu: Send Log to James… packs your log into one zip and opens an email to James (nothing is sent by itself).

item.title: Build 328
item.description: 0.3.0. A new Settings window: pick how the picture shows (the PictureFollows proxy, Pro Tools' video, or Video Sync), and see only what that mode needs. Pro Tools' video (beta, off by default): Pro Tools' own video window follows RX, SpectraLayers or Acoustica, no proxy made. At 23.976, 24 and 25 it plays smoothly over picture you've just played in Pro Tools; unplayed picture, like a clip's handles, plays a little slower so it doesn't stutter. Screen recording apps can make it stutter. If you close Pro Tools' video window during a send, it stays closed. The video track now decides the picture's timing, and the menu names the movie in use. Optional: a menu bar cue, green in the clip and red in the handles (an outline or a tinted icon). Our window opens where you left it.

item.title: Build 246
item.description: The picture now stays on the desktop where you work in RX, SpectraLayers or Acoustica, and steps aside when you switch to another app. Choose what happens in Settings → "When you switch to another app": Pro Tools' video comes back (the default), Hide all video, or Keep the picture up. When your clips are outside the movie, the picture says whether they are before its start or after its end. Swapping the movie on Pro Tools' video track during a send switches the picture to the new movie at the same spot.

item.title: Build 226
item.description: Multi-Input sends to RX are followed (boom and iso from two tracks in one tab). With more than one movie in a session, the one on your video track is used, and the picture says so when your clips fall outside it. If you opened the app from your download, the menu asks you to move it to Applications so updates install. New and experimental, off by default: Settings → Drive Non-Lethal Video Sync, for Video Sync 6 users.
